lyrics:
[Intro: muted horns, slow warm bassline, rim click]

[Verse 1: female lead, smoky and low]
Little brother's got a system on his phone
Twenty on the late game, he's in the zone
Won on a Tuesday, told the whole block
Lost it on a Wednesday with the rent and the clock
Mama sees the notice and she doesn't say a word
He says one more parlay and he's back, haven't you heard?

[Chorus: three-part female harmony, horns answering]
Don't dive there, baby, you can't see the bottom
Shiny on the top don't mean it's deep
Stay where your feet know the ground they've got
Some water only wants to keep
Don't dive there

[Verse 2: second female voice, gentle]
Pretty girl, sixteen, with a ring light glow
Ten thousand strangers telling her what they know
She shows a little more and the number climbs
She can't remember what she looked like last time
Door's locked. Dinner's cold. Daddy knocks.
She's somebody everywhere except the place she's got.

[Chorus: three-part female harmony, horns answering]
Don't dive there, baby, you can't see the bottom
Shiny on the top don't mean it's deep
Stay where your feet know the ground they've got
Some water only wants to keep
Don't dive there

[Rap Verse: third female voice, bright and quick]
I've been in it, I ain't judging from the shore
Chased a thing so hard I couldn't feel the floor
Somebody threw a rope and didn't ask me why
Just said, "Kick. I got you. Look up at the sky."
So if you're under, I'm not gonna preach
I'm standing in the shallow with a hand in reach
The good stuff's slower and it don't go viral
Come on in where it's clear. Break the spiral.

[Final Chorus: full harmony, horns and organ]
Don't dive there, baby, you can't see the bottom
Shiny on the top don't mean it's deep
Stay where your feet know the ground they've got
Some water only wants to keep
Don't dive there

[Outro: horns fade, one voice: "I got you."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 86 BPM, 4/4, E-flat minor. Slow, warm and swaying, serious without being heavy.

VOICE: Three women. One sings verse 1 in a low, smoky tone; a second sings verse 2 lighter and gentler; the third raps the final verse quickly and brightly. They sing the choruses in tight three-part harmony.

INSTRUMENTS: Muted trumpet and saxophone lines, a slow, melodic live bass guitar, a laid-back drum kit with a rim click and soft snare, a wah-wah guitar, an electric piano, a Hammond organ in the last chorus, turntable scratches in the rap verse.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, horns and bass. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:16 Verse 2. 1:50 Chorus 2. 2:18 Rap verse. 3:02 Final chorus. 3:30 Outro, horns and a spoken line at 3:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1990s Atlanta R&B: warm, live and bass-rich, horns soft, harmonies smooth and wide.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'She's somebody everywhere except the place she's got' at 1:46.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original warned about the dangers of its decade. These are the ones a parent worries about now, and the rap verse is by someone who went under herself.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Watching, worrying, pleading, reaching.
